content:
- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment values) — reduce forecast peak heights.
- Underestimate prices during strong negative sentiment — adjust downward bias by 2–5% relative to recent highs.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast peaks at 1.5x recent high or 10% below prior 30-day average.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 10–15% unless sentiment supports continuation.
- Lagged sentiment effects: if sentiment turns negative after forecast peak, reduce forecast by 5–10% per day of negative sentiment accumulation.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate volatility in early/late cycles — smooth out extremes with 10-day moving average filter.
